name: rush_hour_benchmark_320_minmove_12_15
description: A benchmark of Rush Hour puzzle instances designed to evaluate planning and reinforcement learning agents on puzzle-solving capability. Instances have minimal solution lengths between 12 and 15 moves, stressing longer-horizon planning and search competence. Used to assess agent success rates and generalization on harder puzzle configurations.
reputation: Niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face for research in RL and planning; limited mainstream adoption.
